gloss: soy sauce dispenser; soy sauce bottle

definitions.gloss: soy sauce dispenser; soy sauce bottle
definitions.explanation: A small bottle or container designed specifically for pouring soy sauce at the table. Typically a glass or ceramic bottle with a narrow spout.

examples.japanese: {醤油|しょうゆ}{差|さ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pass the soy sauce bottle.

examples.japanese: {醤油|しょうゆ}{差|さ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蓋|ふた}→蓋：03896_futa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{開|あ}かない→開く：00689_aku⟧。
examples.english: The lid of the soy sauce bottle won't open easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食卓|しょくたく}→食卓：03246_shokutaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{醤油|しょうゆ}{差|さ}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{胡椒|こしょう}→胡椒：10321_koshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べて→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧おいた。
examples.english: I set out the soy sauce bottle, salt, and pepper on the dining table.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ (soy sauce) and ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧し (dispenser, from ⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧ meaning to pour). The ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧し suffix is used for various tabletop dispensers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {醤油|しょうゆ}{差|さ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to pass the soy sauce bottle around
- {醤油|しょうゆ}{差|さ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補充|ほじゅう}する→補充する：25240_hojuusuru⟧: to refill the soy sauce bottle
- ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{醤油|しょうゆ}{差|さ}し: glass soy sauce bottle

- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧し: oil can, oiler

CULTURAL NOTE:
The classic Japanese {醤油|しょうゆ}{差|さ}し is a small glass bottle with a red plastic cap, found on virtually every dining table in Japan. Fish-shaped ceramic versions (⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{醤油|しょうゆ}{差|さ}し) are iconic items at sushi restaurants and are also sold as miniature packets with takeout sushi.
